sentences.speaker: sandy
sentences.text: What colours do you like for your clothes, Simon?

sentences.speaker: simon
sentences.text: I like warm colours like red and orange. They make me feel happy.

sentences.ipa: /wˌɒt ɑː jɔː fˈeɪvərɪt kˈʌləz, sˈændiː?/
sentences.meaning: 你最喜欢什么颜色，桑迪？

sentences.speaker: sandy

sentences.text: Good morning, Ms Li. May I ask you some questions about colours in fashion?
sentences.ipa: /gˈʊd mˈɔːnɪŋ, lˈiː. mˈeɪ ˌaɪ ˈɑːsk juː sˌʌm kwˈestʃənz əbˈaʊt kˈʌləz ɪn fˈæʃən?/

sentences.speaker: ms li
sentences.text: Sure.
sentences.ipa: /ʃˈʊə./

sentences.speaker: kitty
sentences.text: How can we choose the right colours to wear? Could you give us some advice?
sentences.ipa: /hˌaʊ kæn wiː tʃˈuːz ðə rˈaɪt kˈʌləz tə wˈeə? kˌʊd juː gˈɪv ˌʌs sˌʌm ədvˈaɪs?/
sentences.meaning: 我们如何选择合适的颜色？请给我们一些建议。

sentences.speaker: ms li
sentences.text: Well, it depends on the colour of our skin. Some people look good in warm colours, like yellow, red and orange, but other people look nice in cool colours, such as green, blue and purple.
sentences.ipa: /wˈel, ɪt dɪpˈendz ˌɒn ðə kˈʌlə ɒv ˌaʊə skˈɪn. sˌʌm pˈiːpəl lˈʊk gˈʊd ɪn wˈɔːm kˈʌləz, lˈaɪk jˈeləʊ, rˈed ænd ˈɒrɪndʒ, bˌʌt ˈʌðə pˈiːpəl lˈʊk nˈaɪs ɪn kˈuːl kˈʌləz, sˈʌtʃ æz grˈiːn, blˈuː ænd pˈɜːpəl./
sentences.meaning: 这取决于我们皮肤的颜色。有些人在温暖的颜色中看起来不错，比如黄色，红色和橙色，但其他人在凉爽的颜色中看起来不错，比如绿色，蓝色和紫色。

sentences.speaker: kitty
sentences.text: Which colours go well together?
sentences.ipa: /wˌɪtʃ kˈʌləz gˌəʊ wˈel təgˈeðə?/
sentences.meaning: 哪种颜色在一起很合适？

sentences.speaker: ms li
sentences.text: Try to pick similar colours. For example, wear dark blue jeans with a light blue blouse or T-shirt.
sentences.ipa: /trˈaɪ tə pˈɪk sˈɪmɪlə kˈʌləz. fˌɔː ɪgzˈɑːmpəl, wˈeə dˈɑːk blˈuː dʒˈiːnz wɪð ə lˈaɪt blˈuː blˈaʊz ɔː tˈiːʃɜːt./
sentences.meaning: 尝试选择相似的颜色，例如穿着深蓝色牛仔裤，穿着浅蓝色的衬衫或T恤。

sentences.speaker: kitty
sentences.text: OK, but can we mix warm and cool colours?
sentences.ipa: /ˌəʊkˈeɪ, bˌʌt kæn wiː mˈɪks wˈɔːm ænd kˈuːl kˈʌləz?/
sentences.meaning: 好吧，但我们可以混合 温暖和凉爽的颜色？

sentences.speaker: ms li
sentences.text: Yes. In fact, warm and cool colours make each other stand out, such as yellow and green or orange and blue. But don’t wear more than three colours at one time.
sentences.ipa: /jˈes. ɪn fˈækt, wˈɔːm ænd kˈuːl kˈʌləz mˌeɪk ˈiːtʃ ˈʌðə stˈænd ˈaʊt, sˈʌtʃ æz jˈeləʊ ænd grˈiːn ɔː ˈɒrɪndʒ ænd blˈuː. bˌʌt dˈəʊnt wˈeə mˈɔː ðən θrˈiː kˈʌləz æt wˈʌn tˈaɪm./
sentences.meaning: 是的，事实上，温暖和凉爽的颜色让彼此引人注目，比如黄色和绿色，或橙色和蓝色。但一次不要穿超过3种颜色。

sentences.speaker: kitty
sentences.text: What colours match all?
sentences.ipa: /wˌɒt kˈʌləz mˈætʃ ˈɔːl?/

sentences.speaker: ms li
sentences.text: Black, white and grey go well with any colour. They’re suitable for both formal suits and casual clothes.
sentences.ipa: /blˈæk, wˈaɪt ænd grˈeɪ gˌəʊ wˈel wɪð ˈeniː kˈʌlə. ðˌeə sˈuːtəbəl fɔː bˈəʊθ fˈɔːməl sˈuːts ænd kˈæʒʊəl klˈəʊðz./
sentences.meaning: 黑色、白色和灰色都配有颜色。它们既适合正式的服饰，也适合临时的服饰。

sentences.speaker: kitty
sentences.text: Thanks for your advice, Ms Li.
sentences.ipa: /θˈæŋks fɔː jɔː ədvˈaɪs, lˈiː./
